results.title: Live TV on PS5 launches in the U.S. with 100+ free channels, including sports, movies and anime
results.description: U.S. PlayStation 5 users can now dive into a treasure trove of over one hundred free live channels. This new offering brings a rich array of programming, from thrilling sports events to captivating movies and anime. Best of all, fans can watch beloved shows without any extra subscription fees, seamlessly integrated into the console's media section.

results.title: Composer Harry Gregson-Williams on His Eighth — and Possibly Best — Collaboration with Director Ridley Scott
results.description: The composer of "Prometheus" and "Kingdom of Heaven" talks about reuniting with Sir Ridley for "The Dog Stars," a film that posed new challenges in its combination of the intimate and the epic.
